systems.country_label: permanent civil register; NCRA civil registration database
systems.tiers: National; a biometric population database from which the electoral commission extracted eligible voters aged 18 and over in 2017 and 2022, NCRA enrolling in the field those not yet in it

systems.system: Voter register extraction from the NCRA database
systems.owner: Electoral Commission for Sierra Leone (ECSL) with NCRA, under a revised MoU of 13 July 2020
systems.tiers: National; done for the 2018 and 2023 elections, with application and power failures and data mismatches reported; a periodic encrypted transfer with joint field verification is recommended for 2028

systems.system: Biometric Voter Registration and Voter Verification Kits
systems.tiers: Ward-level registration centres; 2,000 laptops procured for the 2022 update, about 1,700 in poor storage

note: A study of voter registration, out of scope under the typology; the civil register is described only as a biometric population database feeding the voter roll, with nothing on how births or deaths are recorded. The capture is an excerpt, truncated by its own frontmatter's account at 50,000 characters.
